slug: 2025-03-19 Tanzania's digital shift gathers pace with $50 million data centre

facts.fact: The Citizen reports Wingu Africa launched the second phase of its Mbezi Industrial Area data centre in Dar es Salaam, a $50 million investment adding 80 racks to reach 110 and interconnecting 13 operators.

Wingu Africa's CEO described the newly launched Mbezi phase 2 as a Tier 3 data centre (operator statement; no Uptime Institute or TIA-942 certification is cited), with a stated 99.983 percent uptime guarantee.
